trans-unit.source: <html><head/><body><p>PCSX2 is a free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator. Its purpose is to emulate the PS2's hardware, using a combination of MIPS CPU Interpreters, Recompilers and a Virtual Machine which manages hardware states and PS2 system memory. This allows you to play PS2 games on your PC, with many additional features and benefits.</p></body></html>
trans-unit.target: <html><head/><body><p>PCSX2 är en fri PlayStation 2-emulator (PS2) med öppen källkod. Den emulerar PS2:ans hårdvara med hjälp av MIPS-processortolkar, omkompilatorer och en virtuell maskin som hanterar hårdvarans tillstånd och PS2:ans systemminne. På så sätt kan du spela PS2-spel på din dator med många extra funktioner och fördelar.</p></body></html>

@drago2126 Achievements can not be unlocked without tracking. An user can log into the RetroAchievements system, but if the achievement tracking system is off, achievements will not be tracked and unlocked when needed.

@roliverosc Preferential change based on synonym change. Rejected. Since you have done mass changes based simply on synonym changes, I'm also reporting you to the core dev team. This is not Batocera.

@IlDucci User @roliverosc is correct. This isn't simply about a synonym, but rather a matter of translation consistency. The user in question sometimes translates "enable" as "habilitar" and other times as "activar," which undermines the translation of the application. Furthermore, "habilitar" is unnecessarily stilted in Latam Spanish and rarely used in these contexts.

context-group.context: Wait loop: When the game makes the CPU do nothing (loop/spin) while it waits for something to happen (usually an interrupt). AdvancedSettingsWidget ../Settings/AdvancedSettingsWidget.cpp:81

trans-unit.note: "Wait Loop" needs a definition by someone knowledgeable in programming.
@IlDucci im pretty proficient in programming, hope this helps :)
@techg9 Thank you for replying! The comment is old, as the PCSX2 team was able to give us a description (in English, for every language) and add it to the CONTEXT section. Happy translating!

Wait loop detection is a technique used in games to improve performance. It checks if the game's code is stuck in a loop or spinning without doing anything while waiting for something to happen. By detecting and interrupting these loops, the game can free up the CPU's resources, resulting in better performance and smoother gameplay without noticeable slowdowns. It's like preventing the game from wasting time and making the CPU more efficient.
So basically a CPU can go crazy like some ADHD person waiting to receive something and get stuck but it could be doing more interesting stuff, similary like spin CPU and spin GPU where it is a similar situation but there you feed it with bits of useless information to not go to sleep which in that situation would reduce it's clock (and perhaps wattage) and reduce FPS
See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Busy_waiting for reference, the article is translated to 21 languages.

trans-unit.resname: AdvancedSettingsWidget['Pauses the virtual machine when a TLB miss occurs, instead of ignoring it and continuing. trans-unit.source: Pauses the virtual machine when a TLB miss occurs, instead of ignoring it and continuing. Note that the VM will pause after the end of the block, not on the instruction which caused the exception. Refer to the console to see the address where the invalid access occurred.
trans-unit.target: Pausar den virtuella maskinen när en TLB-miss inträffar, istället för att ignorera den och fortsätta. Observera att VM:en kommer att pausa efter slutet av blocket, inte på instruktionen som orsakade undantaget. Kolla i konsolen för att se adressen där den ogiltiga åtkomsten inträffade.

A form of IPC which stands for Inter-Process Communication. It refers to the mechanisms and techniques used by different processes or programs running on a computer to communicate and share data with each other. IPC allows processes to exchange information, synchronize their activities, and coordinate their actions.
IPC stands for Inter-Process Communication. It refers to the mechanisms and techniques used by different processes or programs running on a computer to communicate and share data with each other. IPC allows processes to exchange information, synchronize their activities, and coordinate their actions.
There are various methods of IPC, including:
Shared Memory: Processes can access the same region of memory, enabling them to share data by reading from and writing to that shared memory location.
Message Passing: Processes send and receive messages to communicate with each other. Messages can contain data, instructions, or requests for action.
Pipes and FIFOs: These are channels that connect the output of one process to the input of another process, allowing them to communicate by sending data through the pipe.
Sockets: Processes can communicate over a network using network sockets, which provide a bidirectional communication channel between two endpoints.
Signals: Processes can send signals to each other to notify events, handle interrupts, or communicate specific conditions.
Where-as Pine is focusing on Sockets aspect primarily

trans-unit.note:
From the SoundTouch manual:
General optimizations:
The time-stretch routine has a 'quick' mode that substantially speeds up the algorithm but may slightly compromise the sound quality. This mode is activated by calling SoundTouch::setSetting() function with parameter id of SETTING_USE_QUICKSEEK and value "1", i.e.
setSetting(SETTING_USE_QUICKSEEK, 1);

trans-unit.resname: ControllerMappingSettingsDialog['{[=-lt;-=]}html{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}head/{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}span style={[=-quot;-=]} font-weight:700;{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}Controller Mapping Settings{[=-lt;-=]}/span{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}br/{[=-gt;-=]}These settings fine-tune the behavior when mapping physical controllers to the emulated controllers.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/html{[=-gt;-=]}']
trans-unit.source: <html><head/><body><p><span style=" font-weight:700;">Controller Mapping Settings</span><br/>These settings fine-tune the behavior when mapping physical controllers to the emulated controllers.</p></body></html>
trans-unit.target: <html><head/><body><p><span style=" font-weight:700;">Inställningar för handkontrollermappning</span><br/>Dessa inställningar finjusterar beteenden vid mappning av fysiska kontroller till de emulerade kontrollerna.</p></body></html>

trans-unit.resname: ControllerMappingSettingsDialog['{[=-lt;-=]}html{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}head/{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}Some third party controllers incorrectly flag their analog sticks as inverted on the positive component, but not negative.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}As a result, the analog stick will be {[=-amp;quot;-=]}stuck on{[=-amp;quot;-=]} even while resting at neutral position. {[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}Enabling this setting will tell PCSX2 to ignore inversion flags when creating mappings, allowing such controllers to function normally.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/html{[=-gt;-=]}']
trans-unit.source: <html><head/><body><p>Some third party controllers incorrectly flag their analog sticks as inverted on the positive component, but not negative.</p><p>As a result, the analog stick will be &quot;stuck on&quot; even while resting at neutral position. </p><p>Enabling this setting will tell PCSX2 to ignore inversion flags when creating mappings, allowing such controllers to function normally.</p></body></html>
trans-unit.target: <html><head/><body><p>En del tredjepartskontroller flaggar felaktigt sina analoga styrspakar som inverterade på den positiva komponenten, men inte den negativa.</p><p>Som följd av detta kommer de analoga styrspakarna bli &quot;fastna på&quot; även när de vilar i neutral position. </p><p>Att aktivera denna inställning säger åt PCSX2 att ignorera inverteringsflaggningar när mappningar skapas, så att sådana kontroller kommer fungera normalt.</p></body></html>

trans-unit.resname: ControllerMouseSettingsDialog['{[=-lt;-=]}html{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}head/{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}span style={[=-quot;-=]} font-weight:700;{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}Mouse Mapping Settings{[=-lt;-=]}/span{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}br/{[=-gt;-=]}These settings fine-tune the behavior when mapping a mouse to the emulated controller.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/html{[=-gt;-=]}']
trans-unit.source: <html><head/><body><p><span style=" font-weight:700;">Mouse Mapping Settings</span><br/>These settings fine-tune the behavior when mapping a mouse to the emulated controller.</p></body></html>
trans-unit.target: <html><head/><body><p><span style=" font-weight:700;">Inställningar för musmappning</span><br/>Dessa inställningar finjusterar beteendet vid mappning av musen till den emulerade kontrollen.</p></body></html>

@nikivarvar I think it's fine, you set the target speed, it will go at that speed if you have enough CPU power, if not, it will go as fast as possible (below the target speed). it's nothing about the target speed not being locked, the target speed is always the target speed, if you can manage that or not depends on your CPU/GPU

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Generally a speedup on CPUs with 4 or more cores. Safe for most games, but a few are incompatible and may hang.']
trans-unit.source: Generally a speedup on CPUs with 4 or more cores. Safe for most games, but a few are incompatible and may hang.
trans-unit.target: Generellt en hastighetsökning på processorer med 4 eller fler kärnor. Säkert för de flesta spel, men några är inkompatibla och kan haka upp sig.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Fast disc access, shorter loading times. Check HDLoader compatibility lists for games that are known to have issues with this.']
trans-unit.source: Fast disc access, shorter loading times. Check HDLoader compatibility lists for games that are known to have issues with this.
trans-unit.target: Snabb skivåtkomst, kortare laddningstider. Kontrollera HDLoaders kompatibilitetslistor för spel som är kända för att ha problem med detta.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Loads the disc image into RAM before starting the virtual machine. Can reduce stutter on systems with hard drives that have long wake times, but significantly increases boot times.']
trans-unit.source: Loads the disc image into RAM before starting the virtual machine. Can reduce stutter on systems with hard drives that have long wake times, but significantly increases boot times.
trans-unit.target: Läser in skivavbilden i RAM-minnet innan den virtuella maskinen startar. Kan minska ryckighet på system med hårddiskar som har långa uppvakningstider, men ökar avsevärt uppstartstiden.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Sets the VSync queue size to 0, making every frame be completed and presented by the GS before input is polled and the next frame begins. Using this setting can reduce input lag at the cost of measurably higher CPU and GPU requirements.']
trans-unit.source: Sets the VSync queue size to 0, making every frame be completed and presented by the GS before input is polled and the next frame begins. Using this setting can reduce input lag at the cost of measurably higher CPU and GPU requirements.
trans-unit.target: Sätter VSync-köstorleken till 0, vilket gör att varje bildruta färdigställs och presenteras av GS innan inmatning registreras och nästa bildruta påbörjas. Att använda denna inställning kan minska inmatningsfördröjningen till priset av märkbart högre CPU- och GPU-krav.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Speeds up emulation so that the guest refresh rate matches the host. This results in the smoothest animations possible, at the cost of potentially increasing the emulation speed by less than 1%. Sync to Host Refresh Rate will not take effect if the console{[=-apos;-=]}s refresh rate is too far from the host{[=-apos;-=]}s refresh rate. Users with variable refresh rate displays should disable this option.']
trans-unit.source: Speeds up emulation so that the guest refresh rate matches the host. This results in the smoothest animations possible, at the cost of potentially increasing the emulation speed by less than 1%. Sync to Host Refresh Rate will not take effect if the console's refresh rate is too far from the host's refresh rate. Users with variable refresh rate displays should disable this option.
trans-unit.target: Snabbar upp emuleringen så att gästsystemets uppdateringsfrekvens matchar värdens. Detta resulterar i så mjuka animationer som möjligt, till priset av att emuleringshastigheten potentiellt kan öka med mindre än 1%. Synkronisering till värdens uppdateringsfrekvens kommer inte att ha någon effekt om konsolens uppdateringsfrekvens är för långt ifrån värdens. Användare med skärmar som har variabel uppdateringsfrekvens bör inaktivera detta alternativ.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Displays the newest frame immediately at the beginning of the frame raster time, instead of at the end. Can reduce perceived input lag, but may cause problems with some games, such as Soulcalibur II and Baldur{[=-apos;-=]}s Gate Dark Alliance II.']
trans-unit.source: Displays the newest frame immediately at the beginning of the frame raster time, instead of at the end. Can reduce perceived input lag, but may cause problems with some games, such as Soulcalibur II and Baldur's Gate Dark Alliance II.
trans-unit.target: Visar den senaste bildrutan omedelbart i början av bildrutans rastretid, i stället för i slutet. Kan minska upplevd inmatningsfördröjning, men kan orsaka problem i vissa spel, till exempel Soulcalibur II och Baldur’s Gate Dark Alliance II.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Uses the operating system{[=-apos;-=]}s date/time format rather than {[=-quot;-=]}yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss{[=-quot;-=]}. May exclude seconds.']
trans-unit.source: Uses the operating system's date/time format rather than "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss". May exclude seconds.
trans-unit.target: Använder operativsystemets datum-/tidsformat i stället för "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss". Sekunder kan utelämnas.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Sets the maximum number of frames that can be queued up to the GS, before the CPU thread will wait for one of them to complete before continuing. Higher values can assist with smoothing out irregular frame times, but increase input lag.']
trans-unit.source: Sets the maximum number of frames that can be queued up to the GS, before the CPU thread will wait for one of them to complete before continuing. Higher values can assist with smoothing out irregular frame times, but increase input lag.
trans-unit.target: Ställer in det maximala antalet bildrutor som kan köas till GS innan CPU-tråden väntar på att en av dem ska slutföras innan den fortsätter. Högre värden kan hjälpa till att jämna ut oregelbundna bildrutetider, men ökar ingångsfördröjningen.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Enable this option to match PCSX2{[=-apos;-=]}s refresh rate with your current monitor or screen. VSync is automatically disabled when it is not possible (e.g., running at non-100% speed).']
trans-unit.source: Enable this option to match PCSX2's refresh rate with your current monitor or screen. VSync is automatically disabled when it is not possible (e.g., running at non-100% speed).
trans-unit.target: Aktivera detta alternativ för att anpassa PCSX2:s uppdateringsfrekvens till din aktuella bildskärm eller skärm. VSync inaktiveras automatiskt när det inte är möjligt (t.ex. vid körning med en hastighet som inte är 100 %).

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['When synchronizing with the host refresh rate, this option disables PCSX2{[=-apos;-=]}s internal frame timing and uses the host instead. Can result in smoother frame pacing, {[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}but at the cost of increased input latency{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]}.']
trans-unit.source: When synchronizing with the host refresh rate, this option disables PCSX2's internal frame timing and uses the host instead. Can result in smoother frame pacing, <strong>but at the cost of increased input latency</strong>.
trans-unit.target: När du synkroniserar med värdens uppdateringsfrekvens inaktiverar detta alternativ PCSX2:s interna bildrutetiming och använder istället värden. Kan resultera i jämnare bildrutetiming, <strong>men på bekostnad av ökad ingångsfördröjning</strong>.

trans-unit.resname: EmulationSettingsWidget['Detects when idle frames are being presented in 25/30fps games, and skips presenting those frames. The frame is still rendered, it just means the GPU has more time to complete it (this is NOT frame skipping). Can smooth out frame time fluctuations when the CPU/GPU are near maximum utilization, but makes frame pacing more inconsistent and can increase input lag. Helps when using frame generation on 25/30fps games.']
trans-unit.source: Detects when idle frames are being presented in 25/30fps games, and skips presenting those frames. The frame is still rendered, it just means the GPU has more time to complete it (this is NOT frame skipping). Can smooth out frame time fluctuations when the CPU/GPU are near maximum utilization, but makes frame pacing more inconsistent and can increase input lag. Helps when using frame generation on 25/30fps games.
trans-unit.target: Upptäcker när lediga bildrutor presenteras i spel med 25/30 bilder/s och hoppar över att presentera dessa bildrutor. Bildrutan renderas fortfarande, det betyder bara att GPU: n har mer tid på sig att slutföra den (detta är INTE hoppa över bildrutor). Kan jämna ut fluktuationer i bildrutor när CPU/GPU är nära maximalt utnyttjande, men gör bildrutorna mer inkonsekventa och kan öka fördröjningen vid inmatning. Hjälper när du använder bildrutsgenerering i spel med 25/30 bilder/s.

trans-unit.note: @MELERIX ¿Podrías eliminar esta traducción, por favor? He checado directamente el emulador en la interfaz Big screen > Cerrar juego y la traducción es incorrecta. De hecho el contexto en la parte de arriba lo señala, aunque a veces lamentablemente no es claro. Sería bueno que lo checaras en lo posible. Me pregunto si hay una manera de ver directamente en el emulador el contexto cuando no es claro.
@-Adad- ok, aunque reset es literalmente restablecer, mientras que reiniciar en ingles seria reboot o restart
@MELERIX No, reset también es reiniciar, busca en un diccionario inglés - español. Te recomiendo el de WordReference. De todas maneras en el contexto especificado reiniciar es lo indicado.

@-Adad- por eso dije "literalmente", ya que en ingles reset es una palabra compuesta de re (rehacer algo) + set (establecer algo), entonces literalmente se traduce correctamente como restablecer en español, pero se entiende que en consolas al traducirlo al español eso pueda ser sinónimo de reiniciar o re arrancar, ya que además de restablecer los parámetros del juego y consola, estás al mismo tiempo haciendo que esta vuelva a iniciar/arrancar.
@MELERIX Tiene ambas acepciones en español "reiniciar" y "restablecer" pero apégate al contexto, abre el emulador y revisa lo que estás traduciendo.
@-Adad- por ello es que la removí.

trans-unit.resname: FullscreenUI['Force a primitive flush when a framebuffer is also an input texture.']
trans-unit.source: Force a primitive flush when a framebuffer is also an input texture.

trans-unit.note: Hint for translators: this is the first phrase of a longer string in QT. Please search for it.

Context mentioned in Discord: Guessing it's primitives being flushed, but I'd want to see context / file to confirm On a real GS, primitives are drawn as they're received, but modern GPUs like big lists of primitives, so we collect primitives in a buffer until the game does something like change draw settings that forces us to finish the list, encode a draw call, and start a new buffer (which we call "flushing").

A definição de Sprite é "imagem ou objeto gráfico bidimensional". Por ser um termo técnico da computação gráfica e do desenvolvimento de jogos, ele não possui tradução direta para o português brasileiro e NÃO TRADUZIR os verbetes é mais interessante. I suggested changes to that effect, but since the current translation is so old and has garnered many upvotes, modifying the entry has become impossible.

@IlDucci ¿Es posible probar una oración sin tener que esperar a una actualización? Si es el caso, ¿cómo se hace?

@-Adad- I'll continue in English, since comments are a shared channel between all translators of all languages.
You can test translations without waiting for official updates like this: - Go to Crowdin's main project page. - Click on your language's name. - On the line that reads "pcsx2-qt_en.ts", click on the three dot icon on the right. - Click on "Download". You will get a ".ts" file on your computer. - Open that ".ts" file with QT Linguist's linguist.exe. You can find portable installations around. Here's one: https://github.com/lelegard/qtlinguist-installers - Click on "Release As..." - Save the new .qm file with the expected name in your main PCSX2 installation folder, inside the "translations" folder. - You should be able to test your changes now.

trans-unit.note:
Na comunidade brasileira do RetroAchievements, o termo mais comum e utilizado para indicar a não obtenção de um objetivo é BLOQUEIO (ou usar o verbo BLOQUEAR). A preferência se justifica por associar o feito ao jargão padrão utilizado nos sistemas de troféus modernos (como PlayStation e Steam). O termo "trancado" também é compreendido, mas é menos frequente na linguagem escrita dos fóruns e redes sociais.
--------------------------------------------------
In the Brazilian RetroAchievements community, the most common term used to refer has not been achieved a goal is *BLOQUEIO* (or the verb *BLOQUEAR*). This preference stems from the association of the achievement with the standard terminology used in modern trophy systems (such as PlayStation and Steam). The term *trancado* is also understood but appears less frequently in written communication on forums and social media.

trans-unit.note:
A definição de Sprite é "imagem ou objeto gráfico bidimensional". Por ser um termo técnico da computação gráfica e do desenvolvimento de jogos, ele não possui tradução direta para o português brasileiro e NÃO TRADUZIR os verbetes é mais interessante. Sugeri alterações nesse sentido, mas como a tradução atual é antiga e acumulou muitos votos positivos, tornou-se impossível modificar o verbete.
The definition of "sprite" is "bidimensional image/graphic object." As it is a technical term in computer graphics and game development, it has no direct translation into Brazilian Portuguese, and leaving the entries UNTRASLATED is preferable. I suggested changes to that effect, but since the current translation is so old and has garnered many upvotes, modifying the entry has become impossible.

I assume "Sawtooth" means how the shapes distort at the edges with this deinterlacing method.

A definição de Sprite é "imagem ou objeto gráfico bidimensional". Por ser um termo técnico da computação gráfica e do desenvolvimento de jogos, ele não possui tradução direta para o português brasileiro e NÃO TRADUZIR os verbetes é mais interessante. Sugeri alterações nesse sentido, mas como a tradução atual é antiga e acumulou muitos votos positivos, tornou-se impossível modificar o verbete.
The definition of "sprite" is "bidimensional image/graphic object." As it is a technical term in computer graphics and game development, it has no direct translation into Brazilian Portuguese, and leaving the entries UNTRASLATED is preferable. I suggested changes to that effect, but since the current translation is so old and has garnered many upvotes, modifying the entry has become impossible.
This should probably simply be "Off"
@HarmfulBreeze Off (None) is fine, the other options are displayed like this.

@refraction "Désactivé (aucun)" is pretty unclear/unnatural in French. Usually in French we use "aucun <something>", "aucun" by itself is to be avoided. Another way to put it would be "Désactivé (aucun filtrage)", "Off (No Filtering)", but it's a little unclear too as people might think the option disables all filtering. I decided to translate it as "Désactivé", "Off".
The decision to update the source string is up to you :)
Related PR: https://github.com/PCSX2/pcsx2/pull/14541

trans-unit.resname: FullscreenUI['Displays the newest frame immediately at the beginning of the frame raster time, instead of at the end. Can reduce perceived input lag, but may cause problems with some games, such as Soulcalibur II and Baldur{[=-apos;-=]}s Gate Dark Alliance II. ']

trans-unit.resname: FullscreenUI['Determines the deinterlacing method to be used on the interlaced screen of the emulated console. Automatic should be able to correctly deinterlace most games, but if you see visibly shaky graphics, try one of the other options.']

A definição de Sprite é "imagem ou objeto gráfico bidimensional". Por ser um termo técnico da computação gráfica e do desenvolvimento de jogos, ele não possui tradução direta para o português brasileiro e NÃO TRADUZIR os verbetes é mais interessante. Sugeri alterações nesse sentido, mas como a tradução atual é antiga e acumulou muitos votos positivos, tornou-se impossível modificar o verbete.
The definition of "sprite" is "bidimensional image/graphic object." As it is a technical term in computer graphics and game development, it has no direct translation into Brazilian Portuguese, and leaving the entries UNTRASLATED is preferable. I suggested changes to that effect, but since the current translation is so old and has garnered many upvotes, modifying the entry has become impossible.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Enables bilinear post processing filter. Smooths the overall picture as it is displayed on the screen. Corrects positioning between pixels.']

trans-unit.target: Aktiverar bilinjärt efterbehandlingsfilter. Utjämnar den övergripande bilden när den visas på skärmen. Korrigerar positionering mellan pixlar.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Enables PCRTC Offsets which position the screen as the game requests. Useful for some games such as WipEout Fusion for its screen shake effect, but can make the picture blurry.']

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['By default, the texture cache handles partial invalidations. Unfortunately it is very costly to compute CPU wise. This hack replaces the partial invalidation with a complete deletion of the texture to reduce the CPU load. It helps with the Snowblind engine games.']
trans-unit.source: By default, the texture cache handles partial invalidations. Unfortunately it is very costly to compute CPU wise. This hack replaces the partial invalidation with a complete deletion of the texture to reduce the CPU load. It helps with the Snowblind engine games.
trans-unit.target: Som standard hanterar texturcachen partiella invalideringar. Tyvärr är det mycket kostsamt att beräkna CPU-mässigt. Detta hack ersätter den partiella ogiltigförklaringen med en fullständig radering av texturen för att minska CPU-belastningen. Det hjälper till med Snowblind-motorspelen.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Convert 4-bit and 8-bit framebuffer on the CPU instead of the GPU. Helps Harry Potter and Stuntman games. It has a big impact on performance.']
trans-unit.source: Convert 4-bit and 8-bit framebuffer on the CPU instead of the GPU. Helps Harry Potter and Stuntman games. It has a big impact on performance.
trans-unit.target: Konvertera 4-bitars och 8-bitars framebuffer på CPU:n istället för GPU:n. Hjälper Harry Potter- och Stuntman-spel. Det har en stor inverkan på prestandan.

trans-unit.note: NOTE: this string is the Recommended value for the Texture Inside RT setting.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Overrides the full-motion video (FMV) aspect ratio. If disabled, the FMV Aspect Ratio will match the same value as the general Aspect Ratio setting.']
trans-unit.source: Overrides the full-motion video (FMV) aspect ratio. If disabled, the FMV Aspect Ratio will match the same value as the general Aspect Ratio setting.
trans-unit.target: Åsidosätter bildförhållandet för FMV (Full Motion Video). Om inaktiverad kommer FMV-bildförhållandet att matcha samma värde som den allmänna inställningen för bildförhållande.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Enables internal Anti-Blur hacks. Less accurate than PS2 rendering but will make a lot of games look less blurry.']
trans-unit.source: Enables internal Anti-Blur hacks. Less accurate than PS2 rendering but will make a lot of games look less blurry.
trans-unit.target: Aktiverar interna Anti-Blur-hacks. Mindre exakt än PS2-rendering, men gör att många spel ser mindre suddiga ut.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Changes the aspect ratio used to display the console{[=-apos;-=]}s output to the screen. The default is Auto Standard (4:3/3:2 Progressive) which automatically adjusts the aspect ratio to match how a game would be shown on a typical TV of the era, and adapts to widescreen/ultrawide game patches.']
trans-unit.source: Changes the aspect ratio used to display the console's output to the screen. The default is Auto Standard (4:3/3:2 Progressive) which automatically adjusts the aspect ratio to match how a game would be shown on a typical TV of the era, and adapts to widescreen/ultrawide game patches.
trans-unit.target: Ändrar det bildförhållande som används för att visa konsolens utdata på skärmen. Standardinställningen är Auto Standard (4:3/3:2 Progressiv) som automatiskt justerar bildförhållandet för att matcha hur ett spel skulle visas på en typisk TV för den tiden, och anpassar sig till bredbild/ultrawide-spelpatchar.

trans-unit.note: "Display resolution" != "Screen resolution". This is the resolution at which the game is displayed. It can be equal to, or different from, screen resolution.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Selects the quality at which screenshots will be compressed. Higher values preserve more detail for JPEG and WebP, and reduce file size for PNG.']
trans-unit.source: Selects the quality at which screenshots will be compressed. Higher values preserve more detail for JPEG and WebP, and reduce file size for PNG.
trans-unit.target: Väljer den kvalitet med vilken skärmdumpar komprimeras. Högre värden bevarar fler detaljer för JPEG och WebP, och minskar filstorleken för PNG.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Enables mipmapping, which some games require to render correctly. Mipmapping uses progressively lower resolution variants of textures at progressively further distances to reduce processing load and avoid visual artifacts.']
trans-unit.source: Enables mipmapping, which some games require to render correctly. Mipmapping uses progressively lower resolution variants of textures at progressively further distances to reduce processing load and avoid visual artifacts.
trans-unit.target: Aktiverar mipmapping, som vissa spel kräver för att återges korrekt. Mipmapping använder varianter av texturer med allt lägre upplösning på allt längre avstånd för att minska belastningen på processorn och undvika visuella artefakter.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Enables accurate alpha testing, which some games require to render correctly. This may require more draw calls and result in a speed penalty.']
trans-unit.source: Enables accurate alpha testing, which some games require to render correctly. This may require more draw calls and result in a speed penalty.
trans-unit.target: Aktiverar noggrant alfatest, vilket vissa spel behöver för korrekt rendering. Det kan kräva fler ritningsanrop och försämra prestandan.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Enables AA1 (PS2 antialiasing), which some games require to render correctly. This may result in a heavy performance penalty.']
trans-unit.source: Enables AA1 (PS2 antialiasing), which some games require to render correctly. This may result in a heavy performance penalty.
trans-unit.target: Aktiverar AA1 (PS2-kantutjämning), vilket vissa spel behöver för korrekt rendering. Detta kan ge en stor prestandaförlust.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Changes what filtering algorithm is used to map textures to surfaces.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Nearest: Makes no attempt to blend colors.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Bilinear (Forced): Will blend colors together to remove harsh edges between different colored pixels even if the game told the PS2 not to.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Bilinear (PS2): Will apply filtering to all surfaces that a game instructs the PS2 to filter.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Bilinear (Forced Excluding Sprites): Will apply filtering to all surfaces, even if the game told the PS2 not to, except sprites.']
trans-unit.source: Changes what filtering algorithm is used to map textures to surfaces.<br> Nearest: Makes no attempt to blend colors.<br> Bilinear (Forced): Will blend colors together to remove harsh edges between different colored pixels even if the game told the PS2 not to.<br> Bilinear (PS2): Will apply filtering to all surfaces that a game instructs the PS2 to filter.<br> Bilinear (Forced Excluding Sprites): Will apply filtering to all surfaces, even if the game told the PS2 not to, except sprites.
trans-unit.target: Ändrar vilken filtreringsalgoritm som används för att mappa texturer till ytor.<br> Närmast: Gör inga försök att blanda färger.<br> Bilineär (tvingad): Blandar ihop färger för att ta bort hårda kanter mellan olikfärgade pixlar även om spelet sagt till PS2 att inte göra det.<br> Bilinear (PS2): Tillämpar filtrering på alla ytor som ett spel instruerar PS2 att filtrera.<br> Bilinear (Forced Excluding Sprites): Tillämpar filtrering på alla ytor, även om spelet har sagt åt PS2 att inte göra det, utom sprites.
trans-unit.note:
A definição de Sprite é "imagem ou objeto gráfico bidimensional". Por ser um termo técnico da computação gráfica e do desenvolvimento de jogos, ele não possui tradução direta para o português brasileiro e NÃO TRADUZIR os verbetes é mais interessante. Sugeri alterações nesse sentido, mas como a tradução atual é antiga e acumulou muitos votos positivos, tornou-se impossível modificar o verbete.
The definition of "sprite" is "bidimensional image/graphic object." As it is a technical term in computer graphics and game development, it has no direct translation into Brazilian Portuguese, and leaving the entries UNTRASLATED is preferable. I suggested changes to that effect, but since the current translation is so old and has garnered many upvotes, modifying the entry has become impossible.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Reduces blurriness of large textures applied to small, steeply angled surfaces by sampling colors from the two nearest Mipmaps. Requires Mipmapping to be {[=-apos;-=]}on{[=-apos;-=]}.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Off: Disables the feature.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Trilinear (PS2): Applies Trilinear filtering to all surfaces that a game instructs the PS2 to.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Trilinear (Forced): Applies Trilinear filtering to all surfaces, even if the game told the PS2 not to.']
trans-unit.source: Reduces blurriness of large textures applied to small, steeply angled surfaces by sampling colors from the two nearest Mipmaps. Requires Mipmapping to be 'on'.<br> Off: Disables the feature.<br> Trilinear (PS2): Applies Trilinear filtering to all surfaces that a game instructs the PS2 to.<br> Trilinear (Forced): Applies Trilinear filtering to all surfaces, even if the game told the PS2 not to.
trans-unit.target: Minskar oskärpan i stora texturer som appliceras på små, brant vinklade ytor genom att sampla färger från de två närmaste Mipmaps. Kräver att Mipmapping är "på".<br> Av: Inaktiverar funktionen.<br> Trilinear (PS2): Tillämpar trilinjär filtrering på alla ytor som ett spel instruerar PS2 att filtrera.<br> Trilinear (Forced): Tillämpar trilinjär filtrering på alla ytor, även om spelet har sagt åt PS2 att inte göra det.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Does useless work on the CPU during readbacks to prevent it from going to into powersave modes. May improve performance during readbacks but with a significant increase in power usage.']
trans-unit.source: Does useless work on the CPU during readbacks to prevent it from going to into powersave modes. May improve performance during readbacks but with a significant increase in power usage.
trans-unit.target: Utför värdelöst arbete på processorn under återläsningar för att förhindra att den går in i energisparläge. Kan förbättra prestandan under återläsningar men med en betydande ökning av strömförbrukningen.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Submits useless work to the GPU during readbacks to prevent it from going into powersave modes. May improve performance during readbacks but with a significant increase in power usage.']
trans-unit.source: Submits useless work to the GPU during readbacks to prevent it from going into powersave modes. May improve performance during readbacks but with a significant increase in power usage.
trans-unit.target: Överlämnar värdelöst arbete till GPU:n under återläsningar för att förhindra att den går in i energisparläge. Kan förbättra prestandan under återläsningar men med en betydande ökning av strömförbrukningen.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Number of rendering threads: 0 for single thread, 2 or more for multithread (1 is for debugging). 2 to 4 threads is recommended, any more than that is likely to be slower instead of faster.']
trans-unit.source: Number of rendering threads: 0 for single thread, 2 or more for multithread (1 is for debugging). 2 to 4 threads is recommended, any more than that is likely to be slower instead of faster.
trans-unit.target: Antal renderingstrådar: 0 för enstaka trådar, 2 eller fler för flera trådar (1 är för felsökning). 2 till 4 trådar rekommenderas, fler än så kommer sannolikt att vara långsammare istället för snabbare.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Reduces texture aliasing at extreme viewing angles.']
trans-unit.source: Reduces texture aliasing at extreme viewing angles.
trans-unit.note: If i'm getting this correctly, Aliasing here doesn't refer to the jagged diagonal lines in rendering but the more general meaning of aliasing in computer graphics (see: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aliasing ). Is "texture aliasing" here talking about spatial aliasing, a.k.a. "moiré pattern", specifically or also about other aliasing artifacts?
@TSnatch72 That is correct, this isn't "dientes de sierra" of pixels from geometry not being smoothed. I'm still looking if there is a proper translation (if exists) of this type of aliasing.

@TSnatch72 I got another answer that might suit the needs: "escalonamiento", by Microsoft: https://msit.powerbi.com/view?r=eyJrIjoiODJmYjU4Y2YtM2M0ZC00YzYxLWE1YTktNzFjYmYxNTAxNjQ0IiwidCI6IjcyZjk4OGJmLTg2ZjEtNDFhZi05MWFiLTJkN2NkMDExZGI0NyIsImMiOjV9&disablecdnExpiration=1701135746

@IlDucci Yes, it's exactly because this is the description of Anisotropic filtering that i chose to use "spatial aliasing" instead, as that's a broad term for aliasing in static images. We could also set it as "moiré patter" as that's what happen when you reproduce an image at an insufficiently lower resolution for it's sample rate, which is what you do when you render a texture at an extreme viewing angle, but texture filtering also handles the sawtooth effect in textures, so i think "spatial aliasing" or just "aliasing" works better as it covers everything the filtering does. "Escalonamiento" sounds like it's referring to sawtooth geometry, though.

@TSnatch72 I'm going to surrender to the evidence and write "aliasing" as a loanword... but adding some context in parentheses for people who might think aliasing is only for geometry edges. What do you think?

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Reduces banding between colors and improves the perceived color depth.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Off: Disables any dithering.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Scaled: Upscaling-aware / Highest dithering effect.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Unscaled: Native dithering / Lowest dithering effect, does not increase size of squares when upscaling.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]} Force 32bit: Treats all draws as if they were 32bit to avoid banding and dithering.']
trans-unit.source: Reduces banding between colors and improves the perceived color depth.<br> Off: Disables any dithering.<br> Scaled: Upscaling-aware / Highest dithering effect.<br> Unscaled: Native dithering / Lowest dithering effect, does not increase size of squares when upscaling.<br> Force 32bit: Treats all draws as if they were 32bit to avoid banding and dithering.
trans-unit.target: Minskar bandning mellan färger och förbättrar det upplevda färgdjupet.<br> Av: inaktiverar dithering.<br> Skalad: medveten om uppskalning/högsta ditheringeffekt.<br> Oskalad: ursprunglig dithering/lägsta ditheringeffekt, ökar inte rutornas storlek vid uppskalning.<br> Tvinga 32 bitar: behandlar alla ritningar som 32-bitars för att undvika bandning och dithering.

trans-unit.note: @IlDucci "Half" refers to an option, to this one (as some one referred there): https://crowdin.com/editor/pcsx2-emulator/15/en-es?view=comfortable#4841 It would be good to fix the translation here.
@-Adad- Good catch, correcting.

A definição de Sprite é "imagem ou objeto gráfico bidimensional". Por ser um termo técnico da computação gráfica e do desenvolvimento de jogos, ele não possui tradução direta para o português brasileiro e NÃO TRADUZIR os verbetes é mais interessante. Sugeri alterações nesse sentido, mas como a tradução atual é antiga e acumulou muitos votos positivos, tornou-se impossível modificar o verbete.
The definition of "sprite" is "bidimensional image/graphic object." As it is a technical term in computer graphics and game development, it has no direct translation into Brazilian Portuguese, and leaving the entries UNTRASLATED is preferable. I suggested changes to that effect, but since the current translation is so old and has garnered many upvotes, modifying the entry has become impossible.

trans-unit.target: Offset för ST/UV-texturkoordinaterna. Fixar en del udda texturproblem och kan även fixa en del efterbearbetningsjustering.

trans-unit.resname: GraphicsSettingsWidget['Skips synchronizing with the GS thread and host GPU for GS downloads. Can result in a large speed boost on slower systems, at the cost of many broken graphical effects. If games are broken and you have this option enabled, please disable it first.']
trans-unit.source: Skips synchronizing with the GS thread and host GPU for GS downloads. Can result in a large speed boost on slower systems, at the cost of many broken graphical effects. If games are broken and you have this option enabled, please disable it first.
trans-unit.target: Hoppar över synkroniseringen med GS-tråden och värd-GPU:n för GS-hämtningar. Kan resultera i en stor hastighetsökning på långsammare system, på bekostnad av många trasiga grafiska effekter. Om spel är trasiga och du har det här alternativet aktiverat, inaktivera det först.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Automatically checks for updates to the program on startup. Updates can be deferred until later or skipped entirely.']
trans-unit.source: Automatically checks for updates to the program on startup. Updates can be deferred until later or skipped entirely.
trans-unit.target: Letar automatiskt efter uppdateringar till programmet vid uppstart. Uppdateringar kan fördröjas till senare eller hoppas över helt.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Selects whether the automatic updater checks for stable or nightly builds.']
trans-unit.source: Selects whether the automatic updater checks for stable or nightly builds.
trans-unit.target: Väljer om den automatiska uppdateraren söker efter stabila versioner eller nattbyggen.

trans-unit.note: Strings for the current beta version.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Prevents the screen saver from activating and the host from sleeping while emulation is running.']
trans-unit.source: Prevents the screen saver from activating and the host from sleeping while emulation is running.
trans-unit.target: Förhindrar att skärmsläckaren aktiveras och att värddatorn somnar när emuleringen körs.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Determines whether a prompt will be displayed to confirm shutting down the virtual machine when the hotkey is pressed.']
trans-unit.source: Determines whether a prompt will be displayed to confirm shutting down the virtual machine when the hotkey is pressed.
trans-unit.target: Bestämmer huruvida en prompt ska visas för att bekräfta avstängning av den virtuella maskinen när snabbtangenten trycks ner.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Pauses the emulator when a controller with bindings is disconnected.']
trans-unit.source: Pauses the emulator when a controller with bindings is disconnected.
trans-unit.target: Pausar emulatorn när en handkontroller med bindningar kopplas från.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['For games with both a title in the game{[=-apos;-=]}s native language and one in English, prefer the English title. Affects how game titles are displayed on the game list, window title and Discord Presence']
trans-unit.source: For games with both a title in the game's native language and one in English, prefer the English title. Affects how game titles are displayed on the game list, window title and Discord Presence
trans-unit.target: För spel med både en titel på spelets originalspråk och en på engelska används den engelska titeln. Påverkar hur speltitlar visas i spellistan, fönstrets titel och Discord-närvaro.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Show a save state selector UI when switching slots instead of showing a notification bubble.']
trans-unit.source: Show a save state selector UI when switching slots instead of showing a notification bubble.
trans-unit.target: Visa ett gränssnitt för val av sparläge när plats byts i stället för en meddelandebubbla.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Renders the game to a separate window, instead of the main window. If unchecked, the game will display over the game list.']
trans-unit.source: Renders the game to a separate window, instead of the main window. If unchecked, the game will display over the game list.
trans-unit.target: Renderar spelet i ett separat fönster i stället för huvudfönstret. Om det är avmarkerat visas spelet över spellistan.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Hides the main window (with the game list) when a game is running. Requires Render To Separate Window to be enabled.']
trans-unit.source: Hides the main window (with the game list) when a game is running. Requires Render To Separate Window to be enabled.
trans-unit.target: Döljer huvudfönstret (med spellistan) när ett spel körs. Kräver att Rendera i separat fönster är aktiverat.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Allows switching in and out of fullscreen mode by double-clicking the game window.']
trans-unit.source: Allows switching in and out of fullscreen mode by double-clicking the game window.
trans-unit.target: Tillåter att växla in och ut ur helskärmsläge genom att dubbelklicka i spelfönstret.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Prevents the main window from being resized.']
trans-unit.source: Prevents the main window from being resized.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Automatically starts Big Picture Mode instead of the regular Qt interface when PCSX2 launches.']
trans-unit.source: Automatically starts Big Picture Mode instead of the regular Qt interface when PCSX2 launches.
trans-unit.target: Startar automatiskt Big Picture-läget i stället för det vanliga Qt-gränssnittet när PCSX2 startas.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Enable an animated/static background on the game list (where you launch your games).{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}This background is only visible in the library and will be hidden once a game is launched. It will also be paused when it{[=-apos;-=]}s not in focus.']
trans-unit.source: Enable an animated/static background on the game list (where you launch your games).<br>This background is only visible in the library and will be hidden once a game is launched. It will also be paused when it's not in focus.
trans-unit.target: Aktiverar en animerad/statisk bakgrund i spellistan (där du startar spel).<br>Bakgrunden syns bara i biblioteket och döljs när ett spel startas. Den pausas också när den inte är i fokus.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Select how to display the background image: {[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}Fit (Preserve aspect ratio, fit to screen){[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}Fill (Preserve aspect ratio, fill the screen) {[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}Stretch (Ignore aspect ratio) {[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}Center (Centers the image without any scaling) {[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}Tile (Repeat the image to fill the screen)']
trans-unit.source: Select how to display the background image: <br><br>Fit (Preserve aspect ratio, fit to screen)<br>Fill (Preserve aspect ratio, fill the screen) <br>Stretch (Ignore aspect ratio) <br>Center (Centers the image without any scaling) <br>Tile (Repeat the image to fill the screen)
trans-unit.target: Välj hur bakgrundsbilden ska visas: <br><br>Anpassa (bevara bildförhållandet, anpassa till skärmen)<br>Fyll (bevara bildförhållandet, fyll skärmen) <br>Sträck (ignorera bildförhållandet) <br>Centrera (centrerar bilden utan skalning) <br>Sida vid sida (upprepa bilden så att den fyller skärmen)

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Locks the mouse cursor to the windows when PCSX2 is in focus and all other windows are closed.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}b{[=-gt;-=]}Unavailable on Linux Wayland.{[=-lt;-=]}/b{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}b{[=-gt;-=]}Requires accessibility permissions on macOS.{[=-lt;-=]}/b{[=-gt;-=]}']
trans-unit.source: Locks the mouse cursor to the windows when PCSX2 is in focus and all other windows are closed.<br><b>Unavailable on Linux Wayland.</b><br><b>Requires accessibility permissions on macOS.</b>
trans-unit.target: Låser muspekaren till fönstret när PCSX2 har fokus och alla andra fönster är stängda.<br><b>Inte tillgängligt i Linux Wayland.</b><br><b>Kräver hjälpmedelsbehörigheter i macOS.</b>

trans-unit.source: Disable and reset the currently applied game list background.
trans-unit.target: Inaktivera och återställ den aktuella bakgrunden för spellistan.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Sets the opacity of the custom background.']
trans-unit.source: Sets the opacity of the custom background.
trans-unit.target: Anger opaciteten för den egna bakgrunden.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Selects the color theme and styling for the PCSX2 user interface.']
trans-unit.source: Selects the color theme and styling for the PCSX2 user interface.
trans-unit.target: Väljer färgtema och utformning för PCSX2:s användargränssnitt.

trans-unit.source: Selects the display language for the PCSX2 interface, menus, and setting descriptions.
trans-unit.target: Väljer visningsspråk för PCSX2-gränssnittet, menyerna och inställningsbeskrivningarna.

trans-unit.source: Pauses the emulator when a game is started.
trans-unit.target: Pausar emulatorn när ett spel startas.

trans-unit.resname: InterfaceSettingsWidget['Pauses the emulator when you minimize the window or switch to another application, and unpauses when you switch back.']

trans-unit.resname:
MainWindow['Changing advanced settings can have unpredictable effects on games, including graphical glitches, lock-ups, and even corrupted save files. We do not recommend changing advanced settings unless you know what you are doing, and the implications of changing each setting.
The PCSX2 team will not provide any support for configurations that modify these settings, you are on your own.
Are you sure you want to continue?']
trans-unit.source:
Changing advanced settings can have unpredictable effects on games, including graphical glitches, lock-ups, and even corrupted save files. We do not recommend changing advanced settings unless you know what you are doing, and the implications of changing each setting.
The PCSX2 team will not provide any support for configurations that modify these settings, you are on your own.
Are you sure you want to continue?
trans-unit.target:
Ändringar av avancerade inställningar kan ha oförväntade effekter på spel, inklusive grafiska problem, låsningar och även skadade sparade filer. Vil rekommenderar inte att ändra avancerade inställningar såvida inte du vet vad du gör och implikationerna av att ändra varje inställning.
PCSX2-teamet kommer inte att ge support för konfigurationer som ändrar dessa inställningar. Du gör det på egen risk.
Är du säker på att du vill fortsätta?

trans-unit.resname: Pad['Sets the analog stick axis scaling factor. Modern controllers with square pickup zones, e.g. DualShock 4, Xbox One have better diagonal inputs at a range between 130-140%, but this will cause axes to reach max input early.']
trans-unit.source: Sets the analog stick axis scaling factor. Modern controllers with square pickup zones, e.g. DualShock 4, Xbox One have better diagonal inputs at a range between 130-140%, but this will cause axes to reach max input early.
trans-unit.target: Anger skalningsfaktorn för den analoga styrspaksaxeln. Moderna handkontroller med fyrkantiga upptagningszoner, till exempel DualShock 4 och Xbox One, får bättre diagonala inmatningar vid 130 till 140 %, men då når axlarna maximal inmatning tidigt.

trans-unit.resname: Pad['Transforms analog stick pickup zone from a square to a circle, allows for full input at diagonals without also scaling the X and Y axes. Ideal for modern controllers with square pickup zones, e.g. DualShock 4, Xbox One. Setting Analog Sensitivity to 100% is recommended with this setting.']
trans-unit.source: Transforms analog stick pickup zone from a square to a circle, allows for full input at diagonals without also scaling the X and Y axes. Ideal for modern controllers with square pickup zones, e.g. DualShock 4, Xbox One. Setting Analog Sensitivity to 100% is recommended with this setting.
trans-unit.target: Omvandlar den analoga styrspakens upptagningszon från en fyrkant till en cirkel och ger full inmatning i diagonaler utan att även skala X- och Y-axlarna. Idealisk för moderna handkontroller med fyrkantiga upptagningszoner, till exempel DualShock 4 och Xbox One. Med denna inställning rekommenderas en analog känslighet på 100 %.

trans-unit.target: Ställer in dödzonen för aktivering av knappar/avtryckare, dvs. den del av avtryckaren som kommer att ignoreras.

If someone has enough Namco/Sony PS1/PS2 manuals from games with neGcon support, please take a look at those to figure out if there's a consisten terminology for French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch or Greek (or any other missing language).

trans-unit.resname: SettingsWindow['{[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}Summary{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}hr{[=-gt;-=]}This page shows details about the selected game. Changing the Input Profile will set the controller binding scheme for this game to whichever profile is chosen, instead of the default (Shared) configuration. The track list and dump verification can be used to determine if your disc image matches a known good dump. If it does not match, the game may be broken.']
trans-unit.source: <strong>Summary</strong><hr>This page shows details about the selected game. Changing the Input Profile will set the controller binding scheme for this game to whichever profile is chosen, instead of the default (Shared) configuration. The track list and dump verification can be used to determine if your disc image matches a known good dump. If it does not match, the game may be broken.
trans-unit.target: <strong>Sammandrag</strong><hr>Denna sida visar detaljer om valt spel. Ändring av inmatningsprofil ställer in handkontrollens bindningsschema för detta spel till önskad profil, istället för standardkonfigurationen (Delad). Spårlistan och dumpverifiering kan användas för att fastställa om din skivavbild matchar en känd bra dump. Om den inte matchar så kan spelet vara trasigt.

trans-unit.resname: SettingsWindow['Summary is unavailable for files not present in game list.']
trans-unit.source: Summary is unavailable for files not present in game list.
trans-unit.target: Sammandrag finns inte tillgänglig för filer som inte finns i spellistan.

trans-unit.resname: SettingsWindow['{[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}Game List Settings{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}hr{[=-gt;-=]}The list above shows the directories which will be searched by PCSX2 to populate the game list. Search directories can be added, removed, and switched to recursive/non-recursive.']
trans-unit.source: <strong>Game List Settings</strong><hr>The list above shows the directories which will be searched by PCSX2 to populate the game list. Search directories can be added, removed, and switched to recursive/non-recursive.
trans-unit.target: <strong>Inställningar för spellista</strong><hr>Listan ovanför visar katalogerna som kommer att sökas igenom av PCSX2 för att fylla i spellistan. Sökkataloger kan läggas till, tas bort och växlas mellan rekursivt och inte.

trans-unit.resname: SettingsWindow['{[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}Patches{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}hr{[=-gt;-=]}This section allows you to select optional patches to apply to the game, which may provide performance, visual, or gameplay improvements.']
trans-unit.source: <strong>Patches</strong><hr>This section allows you to select optional patches to apply to the game, which may provide performance, visual, or gameplay improvements.
trans-unit.target: <strong>Patchar</strong><hr>Denna sektion låter dig att välja valfria patchar att tillämpa i spel, som kan ge förbättringar i prestanda, visuellt bättre eller ökat spelvärde.

trans-unit.resname: SettingsWindow['{[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}Cheats{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}hr{[=-gt;-=]}This section allows you to select which cheats you wish to enable. You cannot enable/disable cheats without labels for old-format pnach files, those will automatically activate if the main cheat enable option is checked.']
trans-unit.source: <strong>Cheats</strong><hr>This section allows you to select which cheats you wish to enable. You cannot enable/disable cheats without labels for old-format pnach files, those will automatically activate if the main cheat enable option is checked.
trans-unit.target: <strong>Fusk</strong><hr>Denna sektion låter dig att välja vilka fusk som du önskar att använda. Du kan inte aktivera/inaktivera fusk för patchfiler med gammalt format. De kommer automatiskt aktiveras om alternativet för huvudfusket har markerats.

trans-unit.resname: SettingsWindow['{[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}Game Fixes Settings{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}hr{[=-gt;-=]}Game Fixes can work around incorrect emulation in some titles.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}However, they can also cause problems in games if used incorrectly.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}It is best to leave them all disabled unless advised otherwise.']
trans-unit.source: <strong>Game Fixes Settings</strong><hr>Game Fixes can work around incorrect emulation in some titles.<br>However, they can also cause problems in games if used incorrectly.<br>It is best to leave them all disabled unless advised otherwise.
trans-unit.target: <strong>Inställningar för spelfixar</strong><hr>Spelfixar kan lösa problem med felaktig emulering i vissa titlar.<br>Dock kan de även orsaka problem i spel om de används felaktigt.<br>Det är bäst att lämna dem alla inaktiverade om inget annat rekommenderas.

trans-unit.resname: SettingsWindow['{[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}On-Screen Display Settings{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}hr{[=-gt;-=]}These options control the on-screen display (OSD) overlays shown during gameplay.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}Mouse over an option for additional information, and Shift+Wheel to scroll this panel.']
trans-unit.source: <strong>On-Screen Display Settings</strong><hr>These options control the on-screen display (OSD) overlays shown during gameplay.<br><br>Mouse over an option for additional information, and Shift+Wheel to scroll this panel.
trans-unit.target: <strong>Inställningar för skärmvisning</strong><hr>Dessa alternativ styr skärmvisningsöverlagringarna (OSD) som visas under spel.<br><br>Håll muspekaren över ett alternativ för mer information och använd Skift+hjul för att rulla panelen.

trans-unit.resname: SettingsWindow['{[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}Folder Settings{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}hr{[=-gt;-=]}These options control where PCSX2 will save runtime data files.']
trans-unit.source: <strong>Folder Settings</strong><hr>These options control where PCSX2 will save runtime data files.
trans-unit.target: <strong>Mappinställningar</strong><hr>Dessa alternativ styr var PCSX2 ska spara datafiler vid körningar.

trans-unit.resname: SettingsWindow['{[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}Achievements Settings{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}hr{[=-gt;-=]}These options control the RetroAchievements implementation in PCSX2, allowing you to earn achievements in your games.']
trans-unit.source: <strong>Achievements Settings</strong><hr>These options control the RetroAchievements implementation in PCSX2, allowing you to earn achievements in your games.
trans-unit.target: <strong>Inställningar för prestationer</strong><hr>Dessa alternativ styr RetroAchievements-implementation i PCSX2, som tillåter dig att tjäna prestationer i dina spel.

trans-unit.target: RAIntegration används, inbyggt stöd för RetroAchievements är inaktiverat.

trans-unit.resname: SetupWizardDialog['{[=-lt;-=]}html{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}head/{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}PCSX2 requires a PS2 BIOS in order to run.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}For legal reasons, you must obtain a BIOS {[=-lt;-=]}strong{[=-gt;-=]}from an actual PS2 unit that you own{[=-lt;-=]}/strong{[=-gt;-=]} (borrowing doesn{[=-apos;-=]}t count).{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}Once dumped, this BIOS image should be placed in the bios folder within the data directory shown below, or you can instruct PCSX2 to scan an alternative directory.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}A guide for dumping your BIOS can be found {[=-lt;-=]}a href={[=-quot;-=]}https://pcsx2.net/docs/setup/bios/{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}here{[=-lt;-=]}/a{[=-gt;-=]}.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/html{[=-gt;-=]}']
trans-unit.source: <html><head/><body><p>PCSX2 requires a PS2 BIOS in order to run.</p><p>For legal reasons, you must obtain a BIOS <strong>from an actual PS2 unit that you own</strong> (borrowing doesn't count).</p><p>Once dumped, this BIOS image should be placed in the bios folder within the data directory shown below, or you can instruct PCSX2 to scan an alternative directory.</p><p>A guide for dumping your BIOS can be found <a href="https://pcsx2.net/docs/setup/bios/">here</a>.</p></body></html>
trans-unit.target: <html><head/><body><p>PCSX2 kräver ett PS2 BIOS för att kunna starta.</p><p>Av juridiska skäl så måste du skaffa ett BIOS <strong>från en riktig PS2-enhet som du äger</strong> (låna räcker inte). </p><p>När den har dumpats så ska BIOS-avbilden placeras i bios-mappen i datakatalogen som visas nedan, eller så kan du ställa in att PCSX2 ska leta igenom en alternativ katalog.</p><p>En guide för hur man dumpar sitt BIOS kan hittas <a href="https://pcsx2.net/docs/setup/bios/">här</a>.</p></body></html>

trans-unit.resname: SetupWizardDialog['{[=-lt;-=]}html{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}head/{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}PCSX2 will automatically scan and identify games from the selected directories below, and populate the game list.{[=-lt;-=]}br{[=-gt;-=]}These games should be dumped from discs you own. Guides for dumping discs can be found {[=-lt;-=]}a href={[=-quot;-=]}https://pcsx2.net/docs/setup/dumping{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}here{[=-lt;-=]}/a{[=-gt;-=]}.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}Supported formats for dumps include:{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}ul{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}li{[=-gt;-=]}.bin/.iso (ISO Disc Images){[=-lt;-=]}/li{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}li{[=-gt;-=]}.mdf (Media Descriptor File){[=-lt;-=]}/li{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}li{[=-gt;-=]}.chd (Compressed Hunks of Data){[=-lt;-=]}/li{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}li{[=-gt;-=]}.cso (Compressed ISO){[=-lt;-=]}/li{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}li{[=-gt;-=]}.zso (Compressed ISO){[=-lt;-=]}/li{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}li{[=-gt;-=]}.gz (Gzip Compressed ISO){[=-lt;-=]}/li{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/ul{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/html{[=-gt;-=]}']
trans-unit.source: <html><head/><body><p>PCSX2 will automatically scan and identify games from the selected directories below, and populate the game list.<br>These games should be dumped from discs you own. Guides for dumping discs can be found <a href="https://pcsx2.net/docs/setup/dumping">here</a>.</p><p>Supported formats for dumps include:</p><p><ul><li>.bin/.iso (ISO Disc Images)</li><li>.mdf (Media Descriptor File)</li><li>.chd (Compressed Hunks of Data)</li><li>.cso (Compressed ISO)</li><li>.zso (Compressed ISO)</li><li>.gz (Gzip Compressed ISO)</li></ul></p></p></body></html>
trans-unit.target: </p><p><html><head/><body><p>PCSX2 kommer automatiskt att söka igenom och identifiera spel från de valda katalogerna nedan och fylla i spellistan. Dessa spel bör dumpas från skivor som du äger. Guider för hur man dumpar skivor hittas <a href="https://pcsx2.net/docs/setup/dumping">här</a>Format som stöds för dumpar inkluderar: </p><p><ul><li>.bin/.iso (ISO-skivavbilder)</li><li>.mdf (Media Descriptor File)</li><li>.chd (Compressed Hunks of Data)</li><li>.cso (Komprimerad ISO)</li><li>.zso (Compressed ISO)</li><li>.gz (Gzip-komprimerad ISO)</li></ul></p></p></body></html>

trans-unit.source: <html><head/><body><p align="justify">PCSX2 supports RetroAchievements, a service that adds achievements, leaderboards, and extra challenges to classic games.</p><p align="justify">Sign in below to link your account and start earning achievements in supported titles, or create a free account at <a href="https://retroachievements.org/createaccount.php"><span style=" text-decoration: underline; color:#27bf73;">retroachievements.org/createaccount.php</span></a>.</p><p align="justify">Using RetroAchievements is completely optional and not required to use PCSX2.</p></body></html>
trans-unit.target: <html><head/><body><p align="justify">PCSX2 har stöd för RetroAchievements, en tjänst som lägger till prestationer, topplistor och extra utmaningar i klassiska spel.</p><p align="justify">Logga in nedan för att länka ditt konto och börja samla prestationer i spel som stöds, eller skapa ett kostnadsfritt konto på <a href="https://retroachievements.org/createaccount.php"><span style=" text-decoration: underline; color:#27bf73;">retroachievements.org/createaccount.php</span></a>.</p><p align="justify">RetroAchievements är helt valfritt och krävs inte för att använda PCSX2.</p></body></html>

trans-unit.source: <html><head/><body><h1 style=" margin-top:18px; margin-bottom:12px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-size:xx-large; font-weight:700;">Setup Complete!</span></h1><p>You are now ready to run games.</p><p><span style=" font-weight:700;">Warning: Do not run untrusted programs in PCSX2. trans-unit.resname: SetupWizardDialog['{[=-lt;-=]}html{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}head/{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}h1 style={[=-quot;-=]} margin-top:18px; margin-bottom:12px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}span style={[=-quot;-=]} font-size:xx-large; font-weight:700;{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}Welcome to PCSX2!{[=-lt;-=]}/span{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/h1{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}This wizard will help guide you through the configuration steps required to use the application. It is recommended if this is your first time installing PCSX2 that you view the setup guide {[=-lt;-=]}a href={[=-quot;-=]}https://pcsx2.net/docs/{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}here{[=-lt;-=]}/a{[=-gt;-=]}.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}By default, PCSX2 will connect to the server at {[=-lt;-=]}a href={[=-quot;-=]}https://pcsx2.net/{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}pcsx2.net{[=-lt;-=]}/a{[=-gt;-=]} to check for updates, and if available and confirmed, download update packages from {[=-lt;-=]}a href={[=-quot;-=]}https://github.com/{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}github.com{[=-lt;-=]}/a{[=-gt;-=]}. If you do not wish for PCSX2 to make any network connections on startup, you should uncheck the Automatic Updates option now. The Automatic Update setting can be changed later at any time in Interface Settings.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}Please choose a language and theme to begin.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/html{[=-gt;-=]}']
trans-unit.source: <html><head/><body><h1 style=" margin-top:18px; margin-bottom:12px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-size:xx-large; font-weight:700;">Welcome to PCSX2!</span></h1><p>This wizard will help guide you through the configuration steps required to use the application. It is recommended if this is your first time installing PCSX2 that you view the setup guide <a href="https://pcsx2.net/docs/">here</a>.</p><p>By default, PCSX2 will connect to the server at <a href="https://pcsx2.net/">pcsx2.net</a> to check for updates, and if available and confirmed, download update packages from <a href="https://github.com/">github.com</a>. If you do not wish for PCSX2 to make any network connections on startup, you should uncheck the Automatic Updates option now. The Automatic Update setting can be changed later at any time in Interface Settings.</p><p>Please choose a language and theme to begin.</p></body></html>
trans-unit.target: <html><head/><body><h1 style=" margin-top:18px; margin-bottom:12px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; -qt-block-indent:0; text-indent:0px;"><span style=" font-size:xx-large; font-weight:700;">Välkommen till PCSX2!</span></h1><p>Denna guide hjälper dig genom konfigurationen som krävs för att kunna använda programmet. Om det är första gången du installerar PCSX2 så rekommenderas det att du tittar på guiden <a href="https://pcsx2.net/docs/">här</a>.</p><p>PCSX2 kommer som standard att ansluta till servern på <a href="https://pcsx2.net/">pcsx2.net</a> för att leta efter uppdateringar och, om tillgängligt och bekräftat, hämta uppdateringspaket från <a href="https://github.com/">github.com</a>. Om du inte vill att PCSX2 ska göra några nätverksanslutningar vid uppstart så kan du inaktivera automatiska uppdateringar nu. Inställningen för automatiska uppdateringar kan ändras senare i användargränssnittet.</p><p>Välj ett språk och tema för att börja.</p></body></html>

trans-unit.resname: SetupWizardDialog['{[=-lt;-=]}html{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}head/{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}By default, PCSX2 will map your keyboard to the virtual PS2 controller.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}span style={[=-quot;-=]} font-weight:704;{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}To use an external controller, you must map it first. {[=-lt;-=]}/span{[=-gt;-=]}On this screen, you can automatically map any controller which is currently connected. If your controller is not currently connected, you can plug it in now.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}To change controller bindings in more detail, or use multi-tap, open the Settings menu and choose Controllers once you have completed the Setup Wizard.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}p{[=-gt;-=]}Guides for configuring controllers can be found {[=-lt;-=]}a href={[=-quot;-=]}https://pcsx2.net/docs/post/controllers/{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}span style={[=-quot;-=]}{[=-quot;-=]}{[=-gt;-=]}here{[=-lt;-=]}/span{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/a{[=-gt;-=]}.{[=-lt;-=]}/p{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/body{[=-gt;-=]}{[=-lt;-=]}/html{[=-gt;-=]}']
trans-unit.source: <html><head/><body><p>By default, PCSX2 will map your keyboard to the virtual PS2 controller.</p><p><span style=" font-weight:704;">To use an external controller, you must map it first. </span>On this screen, you can automatically map any controller which is currently connected. If your controller is not currently connected, you can plug it in now.</p><p>To change controller bindings in more detail, or use multi-tap, open the Settings menu and choose Controllers once you have completed the Setup Wizard.</p><p>Guides for configuring controllers can be found <a href="https://pcsx2.net/docs/post/controllers/"><span style="">here</span></a>.</p></body></html>
trans-unit.target: <html><head/><body><p>PCSX2 kommer som standard att mappa ditt tangentbord till den virtuella PS2-handkontrollen.</p><p><span style=" font-weight:704;">För att använda en extern handkontroller så måste du först mappa den. </span>På denna skärm kan du automatiskt mappa valfri handkontroller som för nävarande är anslutna. Om din handkontroller inte är ansluten så kan du ansluta den nu.</p><p>För att ändra knappbindningar för handkontroller, eller använda multi-tap, öppna inställningsmenyn och välj Handkontroller när du har gått igenom konfigurationsguiden.</p><p>Guider för att konfigurera handkontroller kan hittas <a href="https://pcsx2.net/docs/post/controllers/"><span style="">här</span></a>.</p></body></html>

trans-unit.note: Traducción verificada en manual de instrucciones para modelo de la consola comercializada para México: https://www.manualslib.es/manual/4476/Sony-Playstation-2-Scph-79010.html

@IlDucci generally the translations for "Español (España)" does not use literal translations, they use more likely interpretative translations, that's why they use "Guardado Rapido" or "Guardar Partida" for "Save State", intestad of "Estado guardado" for Saved State or "Guardar Estado" for Save State.

I will correct myself:
Please follow terms and constructions that are already approved for the European Spanish translation, within the European Spanish translation, and please follow terms and constructions used in the Latin American Spanish translation within the Latin American Spanish translation.

trans-unit.resname: USBBindingWidget_DenshaCon['The Densha Controller Type 2 is a two-handle train master controller with a D-Pad and six buttons. The power axis starts from neutral and has five progressively higher notches of power. The brake axis starts released, and has eight progressively increasing notches plus an Emergency Brake. This controller is compatible with several games and generally maps well to hardware with one or two physical axes with a similar range of notches, such as the modern {[=-quot;-=]}Zuiki One Handle MasCon{[=-quot;-=]}.']
trans-unit.source: The Densha Controller Type 2 is a two-handle train master controller with a D-Pad and six buttons. The power axis starts from neutral and has five progressively higher notches of power. The brake axis starts released, and has eight progressively increasing notches plus an Emergency Brake. This controller is compatible with several games and generally maps well to hardware with one or two physical axes with a similar range of notches, such as the modern "Zuiki One Handle MasCon".
trans-unit.target: Densha Controller Type 2 är en tågförarkontroller med två handtag samt D-Pad och sex knappar. Gasreglaget utgår från neutral och har fem stegvis högre effektnivåer. Bromsaxeln börjar utsläppt och har åtta stegvis ökande nivåer samt en nödbroms. Denna styrenhet är kompatibel med flera spel och i allmänhet fungerar väl till hårdvara med en eller två fysiska axlar med ett liknande utbud av nivåer, såsom den moderna "Zuiki One Handle MasCon".

context-group.context: This controller is created for the Densha De GO! game franchise, which is about playing the role of a train conductor. The controller mimics controls inside of Japanese trains. Both products are only distributed in Japan, so they do not have official non-Japanese names. USBBindingWidget_DenshaCon ../Settings/USBBindingWidget_DenshaCon.ui:242

trans-unit.source:
<p>By default, GunCon2 will use the mouse pointer. To use the mouse, you <strong>do not</strong> need to configure any bindings apart from the trigger and buttons.</p>
<p>If you want to use a controller, or lightgun which simulates a controller instead of a mouse, then you should bind it to Relative Aiming. Otherwise, Relative Aiming should be <strong>left unbound</strong>.</p>
trans-unit.target:
<p>GunCon2 kommer som standard att använda muspekaren. För att använda musen behöver du <strong>inte</strong> konfigurera några bindningar förutom avtryckaren och knappar.</p>
<p>Om du vill använda en handkontroller eller ljuspistol som simulerar en kontrollera istället för en mus så kan du binda den till Relative Aiming. Om inte bör Relative Aiming <strong>lämnas obunden</strong>.</p>

trans-unit.resname: USBBindingWidget_RyojouhenCon['The Ryojōhen Controller is a two-handle train master controller with a D-Pad and seven buttons. The power axis starts from neutral and has four progressively higher notches of power. The brake axis is analogue with three regions representing to release brake pressure, hold brakes at the current pressure, or increase brake pressure. Extending this axis to the extreme triggers the Emergency Brake. This controller is designed for use with Densha De GO! Ryojōhen, and is best used with hardware with two axes, one of which can be easily feathered to increase or decrease brake pressure.']
trans-unit.source: The Ryojōhen Controller is a two-handle train master controller with a D-Pad and seven buttons. The power axis starts from neutral and has four progressively higher notches of power. The brake axis is analogue with three regions representing to release brake pressure, hold brakes at the current pressure, or increase brake pressure. Extending this axis to the extreme triggers the Emergency Brake. This controller is designed for use with Densha De GO! Ryojōhen, and is best used with hardware with two axes, one of which can be easily feathered to increase or decrease brake pressure.
trans-unit.target: Ryojōhen Controller är en tågkontroll med två handtag, en D-Pad och sju knappar. Kraftaxeln startar från neutralläge och har fyra progressivt högre kraftsteg. Bromsaxeln är analog med tre regioner som representerar att släppa på bromstrycket, hålla bromsarna vid det aktuella trycket eller öka bromstrycket. Om denna axel förlängs till det yttersta utlöses nödbromsen. Denna styrenhet är utformad för att användas med Densha De GO! Ryojōhen och används bäst med hårdvara med två axlar, varav den ena enkelt kan fjädras för att öka eller minska bromstrycket.

context-group.context: Ryojōhen refers to a specific edition of the Densha De GO! game franchise, which is about playing the role of a train conductor. The controller mimics controls inside of Japanese trains. For consistency, romanization of 'Ryojōhen' should be kept consistent across western languages, as there is no official translation for this name. trans-unit.resname: USBBindingWidget_ShinkansenCon['The Shinkansen Controller is a two-handle train master controller with a D-Pad and six buttons. The power axis starts from neutral and has thirteen progressively higher notches of power. The brake axis starts released, and has seven progressively increasing notches plus an Emergency Brake. This controller is designed for use with Densha De GO! San{[=-apos;-=]}yō Shinkansen-hen, and is best used with hardware with 14 or more notch settings on an axis.']
trans-unit.source: The Shinkansen Controller is a two-handle train master controller with a D-Pad and six buttons. The power axis starts from neutral and has thirteen progressively higher notches of power. The brake axis starts released, and has seven progressively increasing notches plus an Emergency Brake. This controller is designed for use with Densha De GO! San'yō Shinkansen-hen, and is best used with hardware with 14 or more notch settings on an axis.
trans-unit.target: Shinkansen Controller är en tågförarkontroller med två handtag samt en D-Pad och sex knappar. Gasreglaget utgår från neutral och har tretton successivt högre nivåer. Bromsaxeln börjar utsläppt och har sju stegvis ökande nivåer samt en nödbroms. Denna styrenhet är utformad för användning med Densha De GO! San'yoō Shinkansen-hen och används bäst med hårdvara med 14 eller fler nivåinställningar på en axel.

context-group.context: This controller is created for a specific edition of the Densha De GO! game franchise, which is about playing the role of a train conductor. The controller mimics controls inside of Japanese trains, in this case bullet trains. The product does not have an official name translation, and it is common to refer to the train type as Shinkansen. USBBindingWidget_ShinkansenCon ../Settings/USBBindingWidget_ShinkansenCon.ui:43
Power refers to the train's accelerator which causes the train to increase speed. USBBindingWidget_ShinkansenCon ../Settings/USBBindingWidget_ShinkansenCon.ui:60

trans-unit.resname:
VMManager['PCSX2 requires a PlayStation 2 BIOS in order to run.
For legal reasons, you will need to obtain this BIOS from a PlayStation 2 unit which you own.
For step-by-step help with this process, please consult the setup guide at {}.
PCSX2 will be able to run once you{[=-apos;-=]}ve placed your BIOS image inside the folder named {[=-quot;-=]}bios{[=-quot;-=]} within the data directory (Tools Menu -{[=-gt;-=]} Open Data Directory).']
trans-unit.source:
PCSX2 requires a PlayStation 2 BIOS in order to run.
For legal reasons, you will need to obtain this BIOS from a PlayStation 2 unit which you own.
For step-by-step help with this process, please consult the setup guide at {}.
PCSX2 will be able to run once you've placed your BIOS image inside the folder named "bios" within the data directory (Tools Menu -> Open Data Directory).
trans-unit.target:
PCSX2 behöver ett PlayStation 2-BIOS för att kunna köras.
Av juridiska skäl måste du hämta BIOS från en PlayStation 2-enhet som du äger.
Stegvis hjälp finns i installationsguiden på {}.
PCSX2 kan köras när du har placerat din BIOS-avbild i mappen ”bios” i datakatalogen (Verktygsmenyn → Öppna datakatalog).
